ranges.t: Supervisor of Marine Facilities, Fort Lauderdale

groups.label: The role
names: A 190-slip mega-yacht marina, 10 moorings and 3 public boat ramps
All operations: staffing, maintenance, safety, compliance and revenue systems
Liaison to the Marine Advisory Board, for 25 years
Marine code enforcement, including violation hearings and compliance actions

groups.label: Key achievements, per his CV
names: Annual revenue from about $150,000 to about $1.4 million
Operating budget expanded to about $1.6 million
More than $11.25 million in grant funding for marina and waterway projects
Planning and development of several municipal marina projects

sections.label: Municipal work
sections.title: Lake Park, Dania Beach <t>and St. Petersburg.</t>

groups.label: Marina Harbor Director, Town of Lake Park — 2012 to 2014
names: Turnaround of an underperforming 112-slip municipal marina, with fuel dock, ship store and boat ramps
Revenue from about $450,000 to about $700,000
Capital improvements, including seawall and infrastructure upgrades
Marine events with more than 2,500 attendees

groups.label: Marine consultant, City of Dania Beach
names: RFPs for marina management and redevelopment
Marina design and renovation planning
About $3.6 million in grant funding
Code revisions, vessel regulations and safety standards

groups.label: Grant specialist, City of St. Petersburg
names: Federal, state and local funding for marina development and expansion, dredging, shoreline and infrastructure improvements, and derelict vessel removal
